column1: Blend 500ml of the stock with the can of tomatoes until smooth. Pour into a saucepan with the remaining 500ml of stock and keep warm over low heat.
Heat the olive oil in a large, deep pan over medium-high heat and cook the shallots and rosemary for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice and toast for about 2 minutes until coated and pale golden.
Pour in the wine and stir until it is fully absorbed.
Add the warm tomato stock 1/2 cup at a time, stirring until each addition is absorbed, until the rice is tender but still firm to the bite, 15–20 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the Parmesan and butter. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve right away, topped with a spoonful of pesto sauce.
